## Change

Describe the behavior or documentation change and how you checked it.

## Public release check

- [ ] I have the right to publish the new code, data, and assets, with their required notices.
- [ ] I checked for credentials, personal/customer data, and unpublished third-party code. Private-source imports, if any, are authorized for public release.
- [ ] If packaging or demo assets changed, I reviewed the npm archive and deployed demo contents.
